# platform-orchestrator_scim_group_mapping (Resource)

Maps members of a SCIM group to an organization role. Group display names are matched case-insensitively by the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "platform-orchestrator_scim_group_mapping" "platform_engineers" {
  group_display_name = "Platform Engineers"
  role_id            = platform-orchestrator_role.module_maintainer.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_display_name` (String) The SCIM group's display name.
- `role_id` (String) The UUID of the role granted to group members.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the mapping was first created.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import platform-orchestrator_scim_group_mapping.platform_engineers "Platform Engineers"
```
